summary: DAY expectations/execution pass covered every b03 company while keeping Earth Score separate from valuation and market expectations. Operating evidence is sufficient for lane readiness on the mature/established names and for MBLY; SERV, AUR and SMR remain execution-lane blocked only because present financing/dilution structure prevents reproducible survival/execution treatment. Missing canonical live price/consensus/crowding data is explicitly unknown and is not used as a T0 company blocker.

materialFindings.finding: Execution reality currently exceeds the 2025 robotics downturn: Q2 2026 total revenue $1.329B, Semiconductor Test $1.122B and Robotics ~$100M, with AI compute/HBM demand the principal growth engine. Expectation risk is cycle extrapolation and customer/geographic concentration, not lack of execution evidence.
FY2025/Q4 evidence supports recovering organic growth and margin discipline; execution case should use normalized operating performance rather than impairment/asbestos-distorted GAAP comparisons.

Q2 evidence validates volume execution: six-month revenue +13% and SuperVision revenue +181%, while ASP -1% and expected richer hardware content can pressure gross margin. Narrative-to-reality bridge is positive volume with explicit mix economics.

Deployment growth and 2026 revenue ambition are measurable, but FY2025 revenue of only $2.7M makes the path from fleet count to self-funding economics highly expectation-sensitive. Equity financing is part of execution, not a footnote.
Commercial driverless miles and DaaS architecture support a credible execution pathway, but minimal revenue and high cash use mean technical progress cannot be conflated with economic proof.

Q2 2026 organic sales +14%, accelerating orders and Electrical backlog +43% provide strong delivery evidence against the electrification/data-center narrative. Acquisition contribution and elevated expectations should remain separate from Earth Score.

$44B backlog provides unusually strong visibility but execution depends on conversion cadence, labor/project controls and mix; backlog should support evidence confidence, not automatic valuation upside.
Backlog rising to $2.4B and a >$400M data-center award validate demand capture; concentration makes quarterly conversion potentially lumpy and expectations should not annualize a single mega-order.

Long-duration nuclear/data-center agreements and Calpine scale support strategic execution, while integration and regulatory milestones remain event risks. Those risks belong in execution/opportunity, not as fabricated Earth Score deductions absent methodology support.
Strong 2025 cash generation and multi-GW PPAs support execution credibility; acquisition/integration and hedge/basis sensitivity prevent treating contracted capacity as riskless cash flow.
FY2025 revenue growth and 2026 outlook show operating acceleration, but current backlog combines products/services/tax assumptions; expectations must not value all backlog dollars identically.

Liquidity supports runway but is materially ATM-funded; prospective TVA/ENTRA1 deployment remains nonbinding. Execution credit should therefore be based on licensing/commercial milestones actually achieved, not announced prospective module count.

gatingGaps: normalized fully diluted capitalization and cash runway needed for reproducible execution/financing-risk treatment
normalized fully diluted capitalization and runway needed for financing-dependent execution treatment
normalize ATM dilution into current capitalization and distinguish binding from nonbinding deployment evidence

contradictions: MBLY's rapid SuperVision volume growth coexists with lower ASP/mix pressure; execution strength is not identical to margin expansion.
SMR liquidity is high but equity-financed, so runway and dilution must be assessed jointly.
unknowns: Normalized live price, consensus, crowding and short-interest inputs are not canonical T0 inputs in this pass and remain unknown rather than fabricated.
peerRequests: Company-underwriting/red-team: finish SERV/AUR/SMR capitalization normalization; Chief: preserve opportunity/expectations separation from Earth Score.
